graphs.name: DIM Algebra N=2 — From Paper to Verified Study Material
graphs.description: How the N-body representation of the DIM algebra, its Cherednik and R-operators and the operators on the (-1,r) ray were reconstructed and symbolically verified from Mironov-Morozov-Popolitov, arXiv:2406.16688, and how the study material was produced and published.

en.name: Blank canvas
en.desc: Start from scratch — every kind of graph grows from here.

en.name: Theorem dependencies
en.desc: Definition → lemma → proposition → theorem proof chain inside one math paper, with external citations.

en.name: Paper relation map
en.desc: How papers extend, cite, generalize or contradict each other (cross-paper dependency analysis).

en.name: Task RACI map
en.desc: Task × role map: R responsible / A accountable / C consulted / I informed — spot overload at a glance.

en.name: Org structure
en.desc: Department hierarchy and reporting lines, with per-division colored groups.

en.name: Research collaboration
en.desc: PI / postdoc / PhD students division of labor and deliverable dependencies.

en.name: Conversation map
en.desc: How sessions/topics continue, answer and converge into each other (cross-session knowledge tracking).

zh.name: 空白图
zh.desc: 从零开始，一切关系图都从这里长出来。

zh.name: 定理依赖分析
zh.desc: 单篇数学文章内部的定义 → 引理 → 命题 → 定理依赖链，附外部文献引用。

zh.name: 论文关联分析
zh.desc: 多篇论文之间的继承、引用、推广与矛盾关系（跨论文依赖分析）。

zh.name: 项目任务分工 (RACI)
zh.desc: 任务 × 角色矩阵的图形式：R 执行 / A 问责 / C 咨询 / I 知会，一眼看出谁过载。

zh.name: 公司运营架构
zh.desc: 部门层级与汇报线，支持按部门分组着色。

zh.name: 科研项目合作分工
zh.desc: PI / 博士后 / 博士生分工与成果产出依赖（人类合作模式映射）。

zh.name: 对话关联分析
zh.desc: 多个会话/话题之间的接续、回应与汇聚关系（跨会话知识追踪）。
